name: Nahel
text: Nahel the quiz starts at eight so bring the answer sheets n a couple of pens, im on the door till half seven

name: Makhmudov
text: Makhmudov can you grab the keys off the hook before u leave, the cleaner is locked out of the east wing n shes waiting by the bins, ill be back around six to take them off you

name: Saharat Modesto
text: Saharat Modesto the coach has moved to half past six so theres time for food before we leave, the pickup is still at the leisure centre by the bike racks, bring a fiver for the driver and a spare hoodie cos it gets cold on the way back

name: Soraja Lühs
text: Soraja Lühs the takeaway is coming at eight, do u want the usual or are u trying something new tonight

name: Eyerusalem
text: Eyerusalem the hall booking came through for the 14th so we can run the film night after all, i put a poster draft in the folder if u want a look

name: Bositampen
text: Bositampen the plumber rang and he can only do thursday between one and three, so someone needs to be in the flat to let him in, hes also asked for the cupboard under the sink to be cleared first, can u do the wait or shall i ask the caretaker

name: Gabriela-Mihaela Dzezide
text: Gabriela-Mihaela Dzezide the parcel came while u were out so i left it with the cafe round the corner, they close at six

name: Ularu Meinzer
text: Ularu Meinzer the buses are on strike friday so the usual meet up is off, we can do saturday brunch instead if that works for u, same place by the market

name: Edvaldo
text: Edvaldo the roof man came round and says the leak is from the flashing not the tiles, hes given us a quote that covers the flashing and a new seal around the chimney, if we book before the end of the month he takes ten per cent off

name: Farescour
text: Farescour the train leaves at ten past seven from platform four, dont forget the tickets are on my phone so stay close at the barrier

name: Del Fabbro
text: Del Fabbro the refund finally landed so we can book the hotel tonight, the one by the station is cheaper on the app, have a look and send me the one u like

name: Pernelle Niedrist
text: Pernelle Niedrist the vet says the cat needs the cone for another week and the drops go in both eyes twice a day, shes fine in herself though and eating well, i can do mornings if u take the evening ones, the next check up is on the 8th

name: Muscas
text: Muscas the cash machine on the corner is out of order again, do u know anywhere else open this late

name: Lucas
text: Lucas you are booked in with the dentist on tuesday at 2:15, the surgery is the one opposite the library and they ask you to arrive ten minutes early with your insurance card

name: Laber
text: Laber your eye test is confirmed for monday at 4:40 at the high street branch, bring your current glasses and the form that came in the post, if you need to move it they ask for 24 hours notice, the parking behind the shop is free for the first hour

name: Erenay Vangel Sarode
text: Erenay Vangel Sarode your physio is thursday at nine at the sports clinic, they texted to confirm so just bring shorts and the referral letter

name: El Alej
text: El Alej your MOT is booked for the 21st at 8:30 at the garage on mill road, drop the car the night before if that suits and they will ring when its ready, the courtesy car is free if you ask

name: Azalea
text: Azalea your appointment with the housing officer is on wednesday at 11 at the civic centre, take the tenancy agreement and the last three bank statements, if you arrive after quarter past they may have to rebook you, the bus stops right outside, if you are running late ring the desk first

name: Varghese
text: Varghese your scan is friday at 3:20 at the imaging unit, drink the water an hour before and take the letter with you

name: Di Stasi
text: Di Stasi your hearing test is tuesday at 10:10 at the clinic by the park, the aids are being checked at the same visit so allow a bit longer, bring the spare batteries you were given

name: Contremoulin Odenheimer Scheuhammer
text: Contremoulin Odenheimer Scheuhammer your interview at the depot is thursday at half two, ask for the shift supervisor at the gate and take photo id, the assessment takes about an hour and includes a short driving check, wear the safety boots if you have them so plan for the morning

name: Obiora
text: Obiora your table is booked for six at the pasta place on the square, they hold it for fifteen minutes so dont be late

name: Viebahn
text: Viebahn your blood test is wednesday at 8:40, fasting from ten the night before and only water in the morning, the nurse asked for the yellow form to be filled in before you go in

name: Heida Souter Tshisuaka
text: Heida Souter Tshisuaka your flight check in opens tomorrow at 7 and the seats are already picked, the bag drop closes an hour before takeoff so aim to be there by six, the lounge passes came through as well so take the email, the passport needs to be in the same name as the booking

name: Vasilisa Laure-Isabelle
text: Vasilisa Laure-Isabelle the boiler man is coming between two and four on tuesday, someone has to be home to let him in

name: Elalouf
text: Elalouf your ear check at the audiology unit is on the 12th at 9:15, the test takes half an hour and they ask you to skip loud music the day before, the bus pass covers the trip

name: Blerentina
text: the group order is going in at half five so add your bit to the list now, the app has a discount code for orders over thirty, Blerentina is doing the pickup so she needs the full list before she leaves, we still need someone for the salad and the ice

name: Andreoni
text: the wednesday game is off cos half the team is away, Andreoni reckons we could do thursday instead if the pitch is free

name: Sabeetha Noëline
text: the community fridge needs a restock before the weekend rush, Sabeetha Noëline can do a run to the wholesaler if someone lends a van, the list is on the noticeboard, we can split the cost between the regulars

name: Valbane Rosivania
text: the spare room is finally clear so the painter can start monday, Valbane Rosivania has the colour cards n said she can drop them round later, we still need to pick the shade for the hallway, the ceiling stays white, the skirting gets done last so it has time to dry

name: Zardasht
text: the allotment gate lock keeps sticking so ive put oil on it, Zardasht can fit a new one if it plays up again

name: Labourier
text: the pool timetable changed again n the lane swim is now at half six, Labourier has the new sheet printed if anyone wants a copy at the desk, the kids classes are unaffected so no mad changes there

name: Maël Vehbija Bosshardt
text: the football kit order came in with two wrong sizes so the returns go back tomorrow, Maël Vehbija Bosshardt checked every shirt against the sheet n only those two are off, the replacements should land before the cup game, coats are fine, the coach asked for the new stock to be numbered

name: Montijo Pezzarossa
text: the squash court booking went to the wrong account again, Montijo Pezzarossa is ringing the centre to sort it before friday

name: Sophia
text: the printer in the study is out of toner n the spare is the wrong model, Sophia found a shop that has it in stock so shes picking one up after work

name: Holzinger
text: the fundraising total is up to eight hundred after the raffle n we still have the quiz night to come, Holzinger is sorting the prizes n the tickets are already printed, the hall is booked for the last friday of the month, bring cash for the cake stall

name: Jean-Joel Delmar
text: the dog walk moved to sunday, meeting at the top car park, Jean-Joel Delmar is bringing the spare leads n the treats

name: Petrucciani Melezanovic Papritz
text: the bonfire night food list is nearly full but we still need someone on the gate, Petrucciani Melezanovic Papritz can do the first hour if the second is covered, the fireworks are being stored at the scout hut

name: Fayek
text: just a reminder that the gas check is on thursday between eight and twelve, Fayek will let the engineer in and show him the meter cupboard, the boiler is in the kitchen so the dog needs to be shut in the front room, everything else is ready

name: Buchner
text: your check up is friday at 11:30 n Buchner asked for you to bring the old pair of glasses with you, the shop is by the bus stop

name: Fedorov Lair
text: the car service is booked for tuesday morning n Fedorov Lair will drop the keys off the night before, they said it should be ready by four so we can collect after work

name: Quensel Doychinova Woehrlé
text: the vaccination slot for the little one is next tuesday at 9:20 n Quensel Doychinova Woehrlé has the health book ready, the nurse asked us to bring the red card as well, the wait is usually short in the morning so we should be out by ten, parking is free for half an hour

name: Habtu
text: the physio moved the session to wednesday n Habtu swapped the school run so it works, same room as last time

name: Helbert
text: the viewing is saturday at ten and the agent will be at the gate, Helbert is bringing the reference forms printed and the deposit is payable on the day if we like it

name: Kayahan Talay
text: the driving test is on the 19th at 8:10 at the test centre by the retail park n Kayahan Talay has the confirmation email, the instructor is meeting us there an hour early for a warm up, take both parts of the licence and the theory pass letter, the car is booked for the whole morning

name: Freia Tauriel Ottone
text: the ear piercing appointment moved to saturday at noon n Freia Tauriel Ottone is bringing her own studs, they said to eat first

name: Eugenio
text: the flat inspection is thursday at nine n Eugenio will walk round with the agent, the kitchen and the bathroom need a wipe down before then so lets do it wednesday night

name: Gharb
text: the court hearing is listed for the 3rd at 10 in the morning n Gharb is meeting the solicitor at the office an hour before, take the folder with the tenancy contract and the photos, the usher will call names at the desk so allow extra time for security

name: Vladimer Armenio
text: the bike repair slot is saturday at one n Vladimer Armenio will drop the bike in the morning, the shop is on the high street

name: Malek Karlla N'baili
text: the kitchen fitting starts on monday and the fitters arrive at half seven, Malek Karlla N'baili has cleared the cupboards so move the car off the drive, the water goes off for a few hours after lunch
